evals.prompt: Is this stock a true multibagger or a value trap?
evals.expected_output: Value-trap filter covering: is growth real (CFO vs PAT), debt sustainability (Debt/EBITDA, ICR), cash conversion quality, governance (auditor issues, RPTs, pledge), cyclicality (peak vs trough earnings), sector structural risk, valuation (cheap for temporary vs structural reason), technical confirmation, final verdict with position risk label (Core/Satellite/Speculative/Avoid).

evals.prompt: Analyze one midcap that could compound 5x in 5 years.
